limitations: Only literal zero-argument Unit Compose callbacks passed to supported noninline, nongeneric binary methods are lowered

Source composable declarations and receiver/argument/result/suspend/nullable/generic composable callback shapes remain unsupported; binary composable calls accept only supported static noninline nongeneric Unit file-facade methods and straight-line groups; nested ordinary Unit functions support up to one parameter and stable scalar/String or annotation-free Kotlin interface captures; annotated or unknown class stability, mutable cells and conditional memoization remain explicit unsupported boundaries
Runtime protocol is pinned to AndroidX Compose Runtime 1.11.0 and the Kotlin 2.3.21 bundled plugin; keys and generated class names are compiler-specific

Composer and RecomposeScope are controlled proxies; actual pinned composableLambdaInstance wrappers and generated callback bodies execute, without a real Composition/Recomposer or Android execution claim
